title: Add Standard Tasks with work instructions to Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data
summary: Contoso Coffee manufacturing demo data now includes Standard Task master records with work instructions linked to routing operations, enabling the Standard Tasks page and Subcontractor Price table to have usable data out of the box.
key_points: New codeunit creates 8 Standard Tasks with work-instruction description lines
Added helper methods to insert Standard Tasks idempotently and assign them to routing operations
Routing lines now reference Standard Task Codes, matching operations to tasks like assembly, wiring, testing and packaging
Existing hardcoded operation descriptions are preserved while task codes are validated and assigned
Demo data setup remains idempotent and scoped to W1 only
quote: Adds Standard Task master data + work instructions to the Manufacturing demo module and links them to routing operations
